meta.note: v2: a revamp. Dark values keep the shipped palette; light theme, type scale and the component library are new design, not a transcription of the code.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the app shell's #030712 today; light is Mist, a dimmed slate (#E3E7ED) so the page never glares and cards lift by tone and shadow.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, dialogs, table rows. Light is a soft grey-blue one step above `bg`; nothing in the light theme is pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips (with `shadow-lg`): one step above `surface`. In light the brightest ground (#F2F4F7), still not white.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, menu items, ghost and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected fill: active tab pill, selected row, pressed ghost button.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: editor background, code input, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog and drawer scrim (black 70% / gray-900 40%); pair with a 4px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline: cards, dividers, table rules, header rule.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Inputs at rest, secondary buttons, anything that must read as a control. Decorative level (under 3:1) — controls also get a focus ring.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused input border and the 2px focus ring on every control (4.7:1 on dark surfaces, 3.2:1 on light surface — a 2px ring at that strength is visible; keep it solid, never an alpha). Light is #2F6FEB so the ring holds 3:1 on every Mist ground (3.4:1 on surface-inset, 3.7:1 on bg); the original #3B82F6 was 2.96:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` (16:1 dark / 14:1 light: deliberately softer than pure black-on-white).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, button labels, table body (12:1 / 10.6:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, icon strokes, placeholders (6.8:1 / 6.5:1 on surface — passes AA at every size).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and purely decorative metadata only. Below 4.5:1 in both themes (3.7:1 / 3.1:1): never for anything a reader needs.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the "inverse" button: dark on light, light on dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active switch, checked checkbox, progress bar. Carries `on-accent` (5.3:1 dark / 6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `accent` fills (dark lightens, light deepens). In dark, white on blue-500 is 3.8:1: acceptable for a transient hover on 14px semibold labels, never a resting fill. In light, 7.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active nav, the "drop" in the wordmark, selected tab label (6.7:1 / 6.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent content: selected rows, info alerts, the CreateMenu document tile, badge "info" (blue at 15% / 8%).

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Soft outer ring of a focused primary control and the 25% ring tokens of today's `ring-blue-500/25`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: live badges, "Direct" route, saved toasts (9.2:1 / 5.9:1).

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Solid success surfaces: progress complete, the online dot. Not for text on white.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind success content (toast, alert, badge).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: pending, expiring, "New" tag text (10:1 / 6.3:1).

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Solid warning surface; carries `text-inverse`-dark text (gray-900 on amber-400, 10:1), never white.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, destructive menu items, invalid-field messages (6.1:1 / 5.8:1).

tokens.name: cat-document
tokens.usage: Category tint: markdown documents (blue-700 in light so it holds on the Mist surface).

tokens.name: cat-artifact
tokens.usage: Category tint: artifacts (PDF, sheets, web pages) (orange-800 in light, about 6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: cat-sync
tokens.usage: Category tint: VS Code sync and relayed transfers.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Fenced code block background (GitHub dark / a Mist well in light, 14:1 for `text`).

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: Border of code blocks and the editor well.

tokens.name: logo-ground
tokens.usage: The logo pill: slate-900, the same in both themes — the mark never inverts.

tokens.name: logo-dot
tokens.usage: The blue "drop" dot; also the loader ripple.

tokens.name: logo-drop
tokens.usage: The falling drop and second ripple in MarkdropLoader.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code highlighting: Keywords (7.5:1 dark on code-bg, 5.0:1 light on the Mist code-bg #E6EAEF).

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code highlighting: Comments (6.2:1 / 5.3:1 - comments must stay readable).

tokens.name: syntax-title
tokens.usage: Code highlighting: Function and class names (the tightest light pair, 5.15:1).

tokens.name: syntax-punct
tokens.usage: Code highlighting: Default code text and punctuation.

tokens.usage: Categorical series colour, validated >= 3:1 (light >= 4.4:1) against surface. Colour follows the entity, never its rank.

tokens.name: logo-well-light
tokens.usage: Light well behind a customer logo (for dark logos). Both wells exist in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-well-dark
tokens.usage: Dark well behind a customer logo (for white logos).

tokens.name: demo-accent
tokens.usage: "Someone else's brand" in marketing demos: fixed like a real customer accent, not a category. White on it is 4.54:1.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: QR codes always sit on white for scanners; add a border hairline in light.

tokens.name: cat-image
tokens.usage: FileIcon: images. >= 3:1 against surface and surface-inset in both themes (non-text).

tokens.name: cat-video

tokens.name: cat-pdf
tokens.usage: FileIcon: PDF. >= 3:1 against surface and surface-inset in both themes (non-text).

tokens.name: cat-sheet
tokens.usage: FileIcon: spreadsheets (4.6:1 light on surface). >= 3:1 against surface and surface-inset in both themes (non-text).

tokens.name: cat-audio
tokens.usage: FileIcon: audio. >= 3:1 against surface and surface-inset in both themes (non-text).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The header wordmark, always lower case: "mark" in `text`, "drop" in `accent-text`.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Long-form reading in documents and previews.
styles.usage: Documents and previews (D12): 17/28 on a 680px measure, in text-secondary.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Paste markdown and get a shareable link instantly — no account required.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your name appears on documents you publish and comments you leave.
styles.usage: Default UI copy: forms, dialogs, table cells, menus.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, row titles, menu item names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, metadata, small buttons, badges. `text-muted`.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges, pills and diagram labels: the smallest size that is still text. Never below 11px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and tag text. `text-muted`, or a status colour.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and the editor. `text` on `code-bg`.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code and URLs in running text: `code-inline` on `code-inline-bg`, `radius-sm`, 2px 6px padding.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints in the Kbd component.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge padding, icon-to-text in micro text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit. Tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default inline gap: icon to label, chip to chip.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default control horizontal padding; list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), page gutter on phones, form row gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter at sm+, section gaps inside a page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd, small tags, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs in dense tables, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs, tabs, tiles, the logo pill (rx 8 of 32).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, menus, toasts, drop zones.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large panels, feature cards, the access gate.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting lift on inputs, secondary buttons and cards (light only reads it): a faint top highlight plus a navy-tinted shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The blue halo under the loader mark and primary CTAs on marketing pages; the brand's only coloured shadow.

tokens.name: z-immersive
